I have not heard of Wewush, nor seen their faces. A spirit may speak truth, or may lead us astray. Tell me where they dwell, and how I may know they are hungry; then, if they are near and in need, we shall share grain without making our own children lean.

I do not know this Joawethom, nor whether the dream speaks true. We have grain enough, and a hungry neighbour should not be left to die if aid can reach them. But first I would send a small, trusted party with grain, and have them learn where Joawethom lies and what they can give or teach in return. A dream is not proof, but it is reason to look.
